newsitem.title: MEXICO: Vitro offers 500.7 mln pesos prom. notes.
newsitem.headline: Vitro offers 500.7 mln pesos prom. notes.

text.p: Mexican glassmaker Vitro launched an offering of promissory notes totalling 275 million investment units, or UDIs, the company said in a press statement on Thursday.
The offering, at a rate of 1.820625 pesos per UDI, is worth 500.7 million pesos and the placement period is from March 20-24. The notes fall due on October 29, 1998.
This is Vitro's second offering of promissory notes denominated in inflation index-linked UDIs, following a similar placement of 305.86 million UDIs on December 7, 1996, then worth 515 million pesos.
